brief: Prioritise this ageing unit for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with high loading histories have reduced margins against mechanical failure during heat events, as outlined in MG-023. Where an ageing unit cannot be attended before an event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, as directed by MG-023. Note that the supplied documents do not cover any specific maintenance interval actions for this asset beyond those triage and loading instructions.
